No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you trace garden restoration and historic tombs in a landscape.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Garden entry
  • Selected historic tomb
  • Water/planting corridor
  • Heritage landscape summary

How the time is spent

  1. Garden entry 25 min

    Explain adaptive reuse, conservation and planting.

    You: landscape map

  2. Selected historic tomb 35 min

    Discuss the role of tombs in park design.

    You: photo notation

  3. Water/planting corridor 35 min

    Interpret horticulture and climate design.

    You: field sketch

  4. Heritage landscape summary 25 min

    Contrast historical remains and contemporary garden.

    You: visitor reflection

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Sunder Nursery Heritage Garden using material evidence and a site map.
  • Trace garden restoration and historic tombs in a landscape.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Sunder Nursery, Delhi
For

What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
